source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey (KDHS) 2022, Kids' Recode (KR) file
source_access: restricted -- obtained via an approved data request to The DHS Program (dhsprogram.com); the raw microdata file is not redistributable and is not committed to this repository
age_band: 12-35 months (team-standardized across stunting, immunisation, and SBA -- see Presentation.Rmd § Approach)
extracted_from: national prevalence read from the annotated reference line in Plots/Stunting_forest_plot.png (origin/task2-regional-indicators, rendered by Project7_task2.qmd), 2026-08-04. The same figure's inline prose value did not evaluate at render time (missing `r` engine prefix), so the plot annotation -- not the prose -- is the real, computed number.
methodology: Youngest living child per mother kept per household. Stunting defined as height-for-age z-score (HAZ) < -2 SD, WHO 2006 growth reference standards, among children aged 12-35 months. Estimates are survey-weighted (v005) and account for the two-stage cluster sample design (primary sampling unit = v021, strata = v022).

national.stunting_prevalence_ci_note: not stated in the recovered source; the forest-plot reference line gives the point estimate only

subnational.status: recovered (12-35 month band), not yet reproduced as a discrete CSV in this branch's own pipeline
subnational.note: data/processed/task2_stunting_by_county.csv is the earlier 6-59 month band, kept for the v1 intervention ranking's internal consistency. The current 12-35 month county-level view is the forest plot / map images, not a re-derived CSV (no exact county-level 12-35mo table exists in this repo).
